title: Discovering pyspark and spark-nlp
subtitle: Stylometric analysis of XIXth century literature
format: html
---

{{< include _annotate.qmd >}}

```{python}

stats = (
    result
    .select(
        "title",
        F.size("sentences").alias("num_sentences"),
        F.size("normalized").alias("num_words")
    )
    .groupBy("title")
    .agg(
      F.sum("num_sentences").alias("num_sentences"),
      F.sum("num_words").alias("num_words")
    )
)

import re

vowels = "aeiouyàâäéèêëîïôöùûüÿœæ"

@F.udf("int")
def count_syllables(word):
    groups = re.findall(rf'[{vowels}]+', word)
    return max(len(groups), 1)

normalized = (
  result
  .select(
      "title",
      F.explode("normalized.result").alias("word")
  )
)

syllables = (
    normalized
    .withColumn(
        "syllables",
        count_syllables("word")
    )
    .groupBy("title")
    .agg(
        F.sum("syllables").alias("num_syllables")
    )
)

final = (
    stats
    .join(syllables, on="title")
)

final = (
    final
    .withColumn(
        "kandel_moles",
        (
            207
            - 1.015 * (
                F.col("num_words")
                / F.col("num_sentences")
            )
            - 73.6 * (
                F.col("num_syllables")
                / F.col("num_words")
            )
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "flesch_kincaid",
        (
            206.835
            - 1.015 * (
                F.col("num_words")
                / F.col("num_sentences")
            )
            - 84.6 * (
                F.col("num_syllables")
                / F.col("num_words")
            )
        )
    )
)

final.select(
    "title",
    "flesch_kincaid",
    "kandel_moles"
).sort("kandel_moles", ascending=True).show(truncate=False)

```
